subject: Stratus Systems onboarding — short-term no-PO lane request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@stratus-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stratus Systems — onboarding/PO question for a 90-day trial

Hi Evelyn,

We're excited to get the 90-day integration trial started next week. Quick question from our finance team: can Stratus be onboarded without a purchase order for the initial quarter? Our standard procurement requires a PO but the trial is small (pilot tooling & support estimated ~ $3k/month).

Attached: stratus_w9.pdf (pdf), trial_scope.xlsx (xlsx)

If possible we can accept an invoice-only path with a short-term agreement. Otherwise we'll need a PO which may delay the pilot by 2–3 weeks.

Can you advise on Redwood's flexibility here or point me to the procurement contact?

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships
Stratus Systems
samir@stratus-systems.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@stratus-systems.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratus Systems — onboarding/PO question for a 90-day trial

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Short answer: we can support a conditional invoice-only onboarding for small pilots, but procurement needs a brief approval and a couple of items from your side.

What we need to move forward (summary):
- Completed vendor intake (attached: vendor_intake_form.docx)
- Copy of the signed SOW or scope confirmation (trial_scope.xlsx looks fine; we'll need a line stating acceptance)
- W9 (received)

Tentative approval terms I can propose now: invoice-only for up to $5,000/month for a 90-day pilot (no PO required), subject to:
- Procurement sign-off (Priya copied)
- Invoices routed to billing@redwoodinference.com with the trial SOW attached
- Trial automatically converts to normal PO workflow after 90 days or if monthly run-rate > $5k

Priya / Marissa — can you confirm if that path is OK and whether Legal needs to be looped for a short addendum? If acceptable I'll send a one-paragraph confirmation for Samir to countersign.

Samir — if you can fill the intake and confirm the SOW acceptance by EOB today we can target first invoice on 10/1.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Stratus Systems — onboarding/PO question for a 90-day trial

Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks, Evelyn. Procurement is fine with a short-term invoice-only lane for trials under $5k/month as long as we capture the decision rationale and limit.

I've attached a short decision note (procurement-decision-note.pdf) that documents the exception and the 90-day review. Please ensure:
- Vendor intake is fully completed and signed
- Invoices include the trial SOW reference number: STR-TRIAL-2387

Karthik — adding you for a quick legal sanity check; this should be a simple addendum but want to confirm no additional clauses required.

Priya
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Priya / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I've filled and uploaded the vendor intake form and added an explicit acceptance line to trial_scope.xlsx.
